examples.title: Basic connection indicator
examples.description: A live connection: a pulsing green dot and its word, with no pill around them.

examples.title: Polling vs live
examples.description: Polling reads quieter and different from live through icon, motion, and font-weight — not color alone.

examples.title: Reconnecting with attempt count
examples.description: The reconnecting state showing a retry attempt via the attempt snippet.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ConnectionIndicator } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ConnectionIndicator status="reconnecting">
  {#snippet attempt()}
    attempt 3 of 5
  {/snippet}
</ConnectionIndicator>

examples.title: All connection states
examples.description: Each of the seven states with its own word and glyph: a pulsing dot for live, a hollow ring for out of date, an icon for the rest. The word is always muted and the glyph carries the tone, so the glyph shape and the word carry the distinction, never color alone.
